description: This file contains the implementation of a filesystem-based cache system within the Twig templating engine, including methods for generating cache keys, loading, writing, removing cache files, and managing bytecode invalidation.

classes.name: FilesystemCache
classes.description: Implements a cache on the filesystem for the Twig templating engine, managing cache file creation, retrieval, invalidation, and removal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FilesystemCache with a directory path and options.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a unique cache key (file path) based on a name and class name, using hashing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a cache file corresponding to a given key if it exists.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes content to a cache file, creating directories as needed, with optional bytecode invalidation.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the cache file associated with a given name and class.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the last modification timestamp of a cache file.
